Aggregate Regions and Sectors in GTAP Data

Source: R/GTAP_Dynamic.R
dot-gtap_rd_agg.Rd

Aggregates regions, sectors, or other dimensions in GTAP data.

Usage

.gtap_rd_agg(data_list, agg_mapping, calculation = "+", add_world = TRUE)

Arguments

data_list

A data frame or list containing GTAP data to be aggregated.

agg_mapping

A list containing aggregation mappings.

calculation

Character. Operation for aggregation.

add_world

Logical. If TRUE, adds a "World" aggregate for regions.

Value

The input data structure with aggregated values added.
